1516142.initial:
1. go to Users/ Settings, choose LDAP+Local Users on User authentication method.
2. go to Users&Groups tab on LDAP page. enable Mirror LDAP user option. Apply it.
3. go to Local Groups page. check the mirrored LDAP groups list.
4. stop AD services. Test status was LDAP authentication error.
Refresh Groups Mirrored From LDAP list.
1516142.title: If LDAP communication error, groups remained as Mirrored from LDAP

1516124.initial:
1. Enable "Additional user group ID" through click use and save it in LDAP Schema page. 2. go to Users/ Settings, choose LDAP+Local Users on User authentication method.
3. go to Users&Groups tab on LDAP page. enable Mirror LDAP user option. Choose "Only groups that have member users or groups " and apply it.
4. go to Local Groups page. check the mirrored LDAP groups list.
5. add users from LDAP Server named user02. choose Password never expires on password types.
add groups form LDAP Server named group1 and group2.
6. add user02 to group1 and group2. Set group2 as primary group.
7.test user02 on Test page. 8. Refresh the mirror group list and check in mirror groups.
1516124.title: Enable primary group attribute(AD only)

1516159.initial:
1. go to Users/ Settings, choose LDAP+Local Users on User authentication method.
2. go to Users&Groups tab on LDAP page. enable Mirror LDAP user option. Apply it.
3. go to Local Groups page. check the mirrored LDAP groups list.
4. add users from LDAP Server named user02. choose Rassword never expires on password types. enable Create an Exchange mailbox.
add groups form LDAP Server named group1. enable Create an Exchange e-mail address.
add user02 to group1. Refresh Groups Mirrored From LDAP list.
5. add test user for Local Users.
go to Groups Mirrored From LDAP list. configure group1.
add test to Member Users and Groups. save it
6. go to Firewall /Access Rules, on LAN to WAN policy, set Users Included to group1@ex2003.com.
add a allowed LAN to WAN DNS prolicy if needed.
1 LAN > WAN 1 Any Any DNS (Name Service) Allow All None
2 LAN > WAN 2 Any Any Any Allow group1@ex2003.com None
7. access internet from PC1. it will redirect to FW log in page. login it using user02.
1516159.title: Only users can be added to mirrored groups
